theme: Empirical confidence calibration loop — replaces |composite| heuristic with bin-level win-rates from backtest

compatibility.behaviorChange: When a symbol has calibration data AND the matched |composite| bin has >=20 trades, confidence is now the empirical win-rate (% × 100) instead of |composite|. Without calibration data, behavior is identical to v3.8.

changedFiles.reason: CalibrationBin, CalibrationData, CalibrationResult types + MIN_BIN_SAMPLE_SIZE constant
Bundled registry, empty on first ship, populated by CLI
Loads bundled JSON registry; O(1) lookups
Pure decision-time function: composite → calibrated confidence or heuristic fallback
composeScores takes symbol and consults applyCalibration. m5Bonus path also re-runs lookup. scores.calibration audit field. Confidence-source warning line.
Unit test: empty registry, valid calibration, low-sample fallback, m5Bonus simulation, case-insensitivity
Added resolveJsonModule (for registry import) + included src/backtest/** and src/calibration/**. Fixes v3.8 build bug where backtest was excluded.
Version 3.9.0. Added calibrate + test:calibration scripts. Added test:calibration to default test pipeline.

verification.smokeTest: PASSED — applyCalibration recovers seeded win-rates from synthetic records (60% → 61.0%, 75% → 74.0%)
verification.endToEndCli: PASSED — npm run calibrate ingests backtest dump and updates registry

knownLimitations: Calibration win-rates reflect technical-setup-only decisions because v3.8 backtest stubs news/calendar/macro context. Production decisions apply news filters on top.
Bins are coarse (7 buckets on |composite|). Within a bucket, win-rate is assumed uniform.
No automatic refresh — calibration is bundled at build time. Run npm run calibrate periodically.
Calibration is per-symbol; EURUSD calibration does NOT apply to other pairs.
MIN_BIN_SAMPLE_SIZE=20 is a fixed constant; sparse bins continue using heuristic.
